proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL FOR INCLUSION OF DIVERSITY AS A CEO PERFORMANCE MEASURE
proposals.proponent: NorthStar Asset Management, Inc. Funded Pension Plan
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Compensation Committee to include senior executive diversity (gender, racial, ethnic) metrics among CEO performance measures under annual and/or long-term incentive plans.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST this Shareholder Proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL FOR A REVIEW AND SUMMARY REPORT ON EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION POLICIES
proposals.proponent: Priests of the Sacred Heart, U.S. Province; Zevin Asset Management, LLC on behalf of Carol A. Reisen
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a review and summary report comparing senior executive pay with employee median wages, analyzing pay gap trends, and evaluating pay modifications and layoff impacts.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST this Shareholder Proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL FOR A REPORT ON COMPENSATION DISPARITIES BASED ON RACE, GENDER, OR ETHNICITY
proposals.proponent: Zevin Asset Management, LLC on behalf of David Fenton
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on policies and goals to identify and reduce gender, race, or ethnicity-based pay inequities within the workforce.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST this Shareholder Proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL FOR A REPORT ON NET-ZERO GREENHOUSE GAS EMISSIONS
proposals.proponent: Jantz Management LLC on behalf of Christine Jantz
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating the potential for TJX to achieve net-zero greenhouse gas emissions from company-owned operations by a fixed date.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote AGAINST this Shareholder Proposal.
